result.detail: Timing convention in the testbench: inputs are driven and outputs sampled on the falling edge. After rising edge k the counter cyc equals k. A write is driven at cyc = T-1 so that it lands on edge T, which is how a STATUS clear and a CTRL write are placed exactly on a count-end edge. Both ADDR_WIDTH lanes live in one simulation top, so one simulator.run covers both widths. The upstream reviews are [evidence:prj-f38ca11b11.interface-spec.e1] and [evidence:prj-f38ca11b11.microarchitecture.e1]. This submission has no review of its own yet; it needs independent review after the platform's lint, simulation and synthesis runs.
